blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A product travels from the farm to the customer in clear steps.

First, the farmer grows the sugar. Then, a truck moves it to the factory. Next, workers pack it. After that, a ship carries it. Finally, the customer receives the product.

Every step matters. The truck and the ship work together, and a good route saves time.

items.q: What is the first step?
items.why: "First, the farmer grows the sugar." — é o primeiro passo.

items.q: Who packs the sugar?
items.why: "Next, workers pack it." — os trabalhadores empacotam.

items.q: What is the last step?
items.why: "Finally, the customer receives the product."

items.q: The text suggests that one step alone is…
items.why: Inferência: "Every step matters" — um passo sozinho não basta.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a good route helps the process
items.why: Inferência: "a good route saves time" — uma boa rota ajuda o processo.

blocks.instruction: Ouça você explicando ao Carlos, o novo estagiário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Carlos! Welcome to the team. You asked me how sugar moves from the farm to the customer. It is easy. Let me show you the steps.

First, the farmer grows the sugar on a big farm. This part takes many months. Then, a truck comes and moves the sugar to the factory. The truck is fast, but the road can be long.

Next, the workers pack the sugar in bags. The workers are very important. They check every bag. After that, a ship carries the bags to another country. The ship is slow, but it can carry a lot.

Finally, the customer receives the product in a shop. That is the last step. The truck and the ship work together, and a good route saves time. So we always plan the route with care. Do you have a question, Carlos?
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who are you talking to?
items.why: "Hi Carlos! Welcome to the team."

items.q: How does the sugar move to the factory?
items.why: "a truck comes and moves the sugar to the factory."

items.q: What do the workers do?
options: They pack the sugar in bags.
items.why: "the workers pack the sugar in bags."

items.q: Why is the ship good, even if it is slow?
items.why: Inferência: "The ship is slow, but it can carry a lot."

items.q: Your tone with Carlos is…
items.why: Inferência: você dá boas-vindas e explica com calma — é amigável e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The farmer grows the sugar on a big farm." A farm is…
options: a place where people grow food
items.why: Farm = fazenda: lugar onde se cultiva alimento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ carries the bags to another country by sea."
items.why: Ship = navio: leva a carga pelo mar.

items.q: "A truck moves the sugar to the factory." A truck is…
options: a big vehicle for the road
items.why: Truck = caminhão: veículo grande que anda na estrada.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every ___ checks the bags before they leave the factory."
items.why: Worker = trabalhador: a pessoa que confere as sacas.

items.q: "A good route saves time." A route is…
options: the way from one place to another
items.why: Route = rota: o caminho de um lugar a outro.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We will roll out the new bags next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = lançar, começar a usar algo novo.

items.q: "The boss has to sign off on the route." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o okay.

items.q: "The truck is late, so we need to speed up." To speed up means to…
items.why: Speed up = acelerar, ir mais rápido.

items.q: "The workers set up the machine before the shift." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = preparar, deixar pronto.

items.q: "Carlos wants to find out how the sugar moves." To find out means to…
items.why: Find out = descobrir, ficar sabendo.
